subject: Re: Kickoff: LILA dense-feature service — May status
body:
Hi Lucia, Bao,

Status:

- Eval reproduction done Apr 15, two days early. vitb14 checkpoint via torch.hub.load with pretrained=True matches released numbers on DAVIS and NYUv2; COCO-Stuff was 0.4 mIoU low until Amara found our eval resizing didn't match the release — now within noise.
- Retraining prep: Freya's optical-flow + monocular-depth signal pipeline runs at 71% of target throughput. Main risk to the May 22 data freeze. The flow computation is the bottleneck; we're testing a cheaper flow model on a 10% shard this week — if quality holds on DAVIS J&F we take it.

Trade-off to surface: if throughput doesn't recover we can freeze with ~80% of the planned corpus. My read is corpus size matters less than signal quality here, but flagging since Jun 12 quality parity is the OKR line.

Csilla
